description: Defines the ProxyServer class which encodes proxy server type, host, and port, including related enums, methods, and operators.

classes.name: ProxyServer
classes.description: Immutable class representing a proxy server with type, host, and port.

methods.name: ProxyServer
methods.description: Default constructor for an invalid ProxyServer.

methods.name: ProxyServer(Scheme, const HostPortPair&)
methods.description: Constructor with scheme and host/port pair.

methods.name: FromSchemeHostAndPort
methods.description: Creates a ProxyServer from scheme, host, and port (string or optional uint16).

methods.name: GetHost
methods.description: Returns the host as a string.

methods.name: GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the ProxyServer is valid.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns the proxy scheme.

methods.name: is_direct
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is a direct connection.

methods.name: is_http
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is HTTP.

methods.name: is_https
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is HTTPS.

methods.name: is_socks
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is SOCKS4 or SOCKS5.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Checks if the proxy is QUIC.

methods.name: is_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy uses HTTP-like protocols.

methods.name: is_secure_http_like
methods.description: Checks if the proxy has secure HTTP semantics.

methods.name: host_port_pair
methods.description: Returns the host and port pair.

methods.name: Direct
methods.description: Returns a ProxyServer representing a direct connection.

methods.name: GetDefaultPortForScheme
methods.description: Returns default port for a given scheme.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than operator for ordering.
